editionLabel: ABACUSSPIELE Leo Goes to the Barber, English rules
firstPlayerRule: The player with the longest hair goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The player with the shortest hair keeps the clock; that is a separate role. Turns proceed clockwise.
If another day is needed, the player who would have taken the next turn becomes its starter.
